name: cloud-wallet
description: Diego's Cloud Wallet — standalone cards/passes/tickets Android app. Lifted from Cloud SuperApp's libs:wallet into its own focused APK. Compose-based deck UI: vCards, boarding passes, loyalty cards, QR codes, .pkpass imports. Build via Nix devShell, one APK out.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps (Cloud-Comms hub+forks, Cloud-Nav, Cloud-Wallet, Cloud-IDE, Cloud-SuperApp). The SAME key signs every app so cross-app signature-IPC + the in-app fleet updater never hit a signature mismatch. KEY LOCATION (raw credential + sops passwords live ONLY in the vault repo): A0_keys/providers/android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A0_keys/providers/android/signing.secrets.yaml. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR (default ~/git/cloud-vault) + sops-decrypts the passwords, exporting ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE/ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD which the gradle signingConfig reads. CI does the same via a vault checkout + the SOPS_AGE_KEY secret. THERE IS NO FALLBACK: if the key is unavailable the build FAILS LOUD.

diagnostics._doc: On-device DevControlServer diagnostics → cloud sink. Baked into BuildConfig.LOG_SINK_URL / LOG_SINK_STREAM by app/build.gradle. Empty url = cloud push disabled.

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility — all derived in flake.nix. Bump here, rebuild devShell.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list.

libs:core._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from aa_cloud-superapp/libs/ — settings.gradle points projectDir here instead of at a local copy. Every app used to carry its own copy-pasted tree and they drifted: 6 apps sat 228 source lines behind superapp's updater. One directory, no sync step, no drift.

libs:devtools._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from aa_cloud-superapp/libs/, same as libs:core. Not listed in app.depends_on and not linked in app/build.gradle: libs:core pulls it in with an `api` dependency, which is what gives every app the constellation-wide debug API (127.0.0.1:38090+, own-process logcat) without per-app wiring that would drift.

ui._doc_socials: Me tab — one card per social, sourced from front-diegonmarcos/b-Media/mySocials. Each entry mirrors one page of that site and opens it; the site is the canonical profile, this is its wallet face. Data, not code (FIRE RULE #6): adding a social is an entry here. `accent` is the brand colour as ARGB packed into a number, the same convention WalletStore.Card.accent uses.
ui._doc_me_app_package: applicationId the wallet's `Me` pill launches — cloud-me, which owns the personal-administration surface the wallet does not. Data so repointing it is a JSON edit; blank disables the pill's launch and it reports the app as missing. Baked by libs/wallet/build.gradle into BuildConfig.UI_ME_APP_PACKAGE.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.

analytics._doc: Consumed by :libs:analytics, which reads THIS file (rootDir) at build time and bakes the values into BuildConfig. Both backends are single-site today, so every app reports into the same site and is told apart by .app — give each app its own site_id once per-app sites exist in Umami/Matomo.
